Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that apply nationwide in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, you’ll want to add the province‑specific holidays such as Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc. – see the “Province‑specific notes” section.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | **Sat Dec 30 – Mon Jan 2** | Observed on Monday Jan 2 because the statutory holiday falls on a Sunday. |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba) | Monday Feb 20 | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** | Only in the listed provinces; not a federal holiday. |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Friday Mar 10 | **Fri Mar 10 – Sun Mar 12** | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** | Celebrated on the Monday preceding Canada Day. |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** | Observed on Monday Jul 3 because the holiday falls on a Saturday. |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** | First Monday in September. |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** | Second Monday in October. |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** | Friday Nov 11 | **Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13** | Statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| 9 | **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** | Observed on Monday. |
|10 | **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | Not a long weekend (falls on a Tuesday). |

### Province‑specific notes

| Province | Additional long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|----------|----------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Manitoba** | Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Quebec** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023 (except the federal holidays above). |
| **Nova Scotia** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |
| **Prince Edward Island** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |
| **Newfoundland and Labrador** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |
| **North West Territories** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |
| **Yukon** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |
| **Nunavut** | *No* provincial holiday that creates a long weekend in 2023. |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> Store the holiday dates in UTC or ISO‑8601 format (`YYYY‑MM‑DD`) and flag each as a “long‑weekend” boolean.  
> For province‑specific holidays, keep a separate table keyed by province code (e.g., `AB`, `BC`, `ON`, etc.) so you can merge the data dynamically based on the user’s location.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need the data in a particular file format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
